name: rix-nb
description: Native macOS Markdown and RiX notebook authoring environment

scripts.test:short: bun test --dots docshell/src/browser/browser-document-store.test.js docshell/src/browser/zip-project.test.js docshell/src/file-policy.test.js scripts/host-integration.test.js webview/source/plugin-catalog-core.test.js webview/source/project.test.js webview/source/theme.test.js
scripts.dev:tauri-webview: bun run prepare:docshell && bun run sync:help && bun run build:live-runtime && vite --host 127.0.0.1 --port 1420
scripts.build:web: bun run prepare:docshell && bun run sync:help && bun run build:live-runtime && vite build
scripts.build:browser: bun run prepare:docshell && vite build --config vite.browser.config.js
